settings.heading: Flower Care Instructions
settings.content:
To help your flowers last as long as possible, follow these simple care tips:

  • Trim the stems on an angle when you first receive your bouquet.
  • Use a clean vase filled with fresh, cool water.
  • Keep your flowers away from direct sunlight, heat, and drafts.
  • Change the water every 2–3 days and re-trim the stems.
  • Remove any wilted blooms to keep the rest fresher for longer.
  • If your bouquet includes lilies, remove the pollen to avoid staining.
